name: RewardBench
description: A benchmark dataset and code-base for evaluating reward models used in RLHF, featuring prompt-chosen-rejected trios across chat, reasoning, and safety tasks to assess reward model performance on challenging and out-of-distribution queries.
reputation: Widely used in the RLHF/reward-modeling community as a standard public benchmark for comparing reward models on chat, reasoning, and safety preferences.
notes: Includes datasets with subtle, verifiable reasons for preference; supports evaluation of various reward model training methods.
